name: electro-app
description: Electro App - Shared Monorepo for CRM + ERP

scripts.dev: node ./node_modules/concurrently/dist/bin/concurrently.js --kill-others --prefix "[{name}]" --names "shell,crm1,crm2,crm3,crm4,crm5,erp1,erp2,erp3,erp4,erp5,erp6" -c "cyan,blue,blueBright,magenta,magentaBright,green,yellow,red,redBright,blue,yellowBright,greenBright" "npm --workspace=frontend run dev" "npm --workspace=services/crm1 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/crm2 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/crm3 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/crm4 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/crm5 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp1 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp2 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp3 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp4 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp5 run dev" "npm --workspace=services/erp6 run dev"
